scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed a solid root cause analysis. It correctly identified the two independent root causes, understood the cascading nature of most errors, pinpointed the multi-targeting issue as the primary problem, and provided actionable fix suggestions. The analysis was efficient (17 tool calls, no wasted steps) and the presentation was clear with a good summary table. Minor deductions for not perfectly isolating that FS0039 errors are net472-only (the framework-filtering queries both returned 169 total, suggesting they weren't filtering properly, but the agent worked around this with node-ID queries).

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
